description: Wastewater treatment locations WMS is a dataset listed in Geonorge, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Miljødirektoratet. Tjenesten gir en oversikt over utslipp av kommunalt avløpsvann. Dataene er framskaffet ved den årlige rapporteringen fra kommunene til KOSTRA. Coverage: Miljødirektoratet. The publisher named on the listing is Miljødirektoratet. Its keywords include Kommunalt avløp, Avløpsanlegg. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 0001-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.norge.no/nlod/no/1.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geonorge.
